news.headline: 'It's clear that Moscow is just playing with Washington', analyst says
news.summary: President Donald Trump's envoys told ​Ukrainian officials on Friday that a deal to allow Russian diesel exports is part of a bid to draw Russia back to negotiations after the failure of previous efforts to launch sustained talks to end the war, three people familiar with the meeting told Reuters. news.headline: Qantas flight grounded after bedbug outbreak
news.summary: The flight from Italy to Australia was cancelled after passengers on the plane's previous journey complained of bug bites.
